name: Technomancer
oracle_text: When this creature enters, mill three cards, then return any number of artifact creature cards with total mana value 6 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, mill three cards, then return any number of artifact creature cards with total mana value 6 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

needs.what: an untargeted, on-resolution pick of any number of cards from a graveyard whose mana values together are at most a cap (here 6), e.g. `total_mana_value` on return_from_graveyard's (or search_zones') `objects` with count "any", reusing the engine's _pick_within_total_mana_value so cards milled earlier in the same resolution are eligible
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `total_mana_value` exists only on a target spec (Phoenix, Warden of Fire) and on look_at_top (library only). A target spec is chosen when the trigger goes on the stack, before the mill, so the three milled cards could never be returned, and it makes an untargeted return targeted. A per-card `mana_value` selector caps each pick separately, a much wider card; choose_permanents' max_total_power sums power on the battlefield, not mana value in a graveyard
